Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is our initial renewal quote for your enterprise contract coming up in Q1 2027 (Okta_renewal_quote_2026_v1.pdf). A few highlights:

- Line items split for Workforce SSO, MFA, and Device Posture.
- Standard enterprise T&Cs; I flagged the data-retention clause for your security team.

We can scope a 60-day pilot for device posture (enrollment, evaluation metrics, false positive rate) if you want explicit success criteria before committing to the full SKU. If so, we can set up a short Statement of Work (SoW) and a capped pilot fee.

Attaching: Okta_renewal_quote_2026_v1.pdf and a one-page pilot scope summary.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal review on your side (security + procurement).
2) Clarify pilot metrics and acceptance criteria.
3) Agree on renewal term and DocuSign link for signature.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,

Thanks Sarah — received. A couple of quick questions so we can route this internally:

1) Pilot scope: can you confirm the metrics you propose for success (we care about adoption rate, enforcement false positives, and agent battery/CPU impact)? Please add those to the doc.
2) Pricing: the quote lists a blended seat price for SSO+MFA — can you split out the device-posture SKU so procurement can evaluate the incremental cost?
3) Contract length: our finance team prefers 24-month to smooth capex if pricing is within 12% of the 12-month number. Are you able to offer a tiered discount for 24 months?

Monica / Karthik / Neha — looping you in to prioritize:
- Monica: can you please validate the device-posture pilot acceptance criteria from a product/security perspective?
- Karthik: can you start an initial ask for procurement so we have draft PO language ready?
- Neha: will you own legal review (T&Cs, data retention)?

Happy to sync after you all review.

-Marcus

Thanks for the clear questions — attached is an updated quote that splits the device-posture line (Okta_renewal_quote_2026_v2.pdf) and a short addendum on pilot metrics. Quick answers inline:
- Pilot metrics (per your ask): adoption >= 65% of targeted endpoints, FP enforcement <= 2% on first pass, and CPU impact <= 3% on avg Windows endpoint during baseline tests. We'll log and share telemetry for the 60-day window.
- Device-posture SKU: listed separately on page 3 with per-MAU pricing and a capped pilot fee.
- 24-month pricing: we can offer a 7% additional discount if you commit to 24 months and sign before EOY.

If the pilot metrics look good I can prepare a 2-page SoW and a DocuSign envelope. I’ve also added a proposed escalation path in the SoW for any security concerns discovered during the pilot.

Attaching: Okta_renewal_quote_2026_v2.pdf

Thanks all — reviewed the v2 quote and procurement checklist. Summary and approvals:

- Legal: minor redline on the data-retention clause (Section 7.2) — request retention limited to telemetry strictly for pilot and auto-delete after 90 days unless otherwise authorized.
- Security/Product (Monica): pilot metrics are acceptable; add a clause for an emergency rollback window (48 hours) if critical enforcement issues appear.
- Finance/Procurement (Karthik): 24-month at 7% looks cost-effective; recommend we proceed with 24-month commitment contingent on the retention redline. I'll prepare a short redline request to Okta and sign the DocuSign once they accept.

Marcus — you have my approval to move to DocuSign once Okta confirms the retention language. Please request the SoW with the rollback clause and updated DocuSign link.

-Neha Kapoor
